name: LinkedIn Poll
strategic_objective: Insight gathering, engagement, and conversation-starting around a focused question.

tone: Clear, neutral to slightly opinionated, and professional. Designed to spark thoughtful responses, not just clicks.
copywriting_rules: Ask one specific, non-ambiguous question. Provide answer options that are mutually exclusive and collectively sensible. Use the post text to frame why the question matters, and invite comments to deepen the discussion.
Line 1: the core question or a short setup. Body: 1–3 lines explaining why this matters or what you are trying to understand. Final line: explicit invitation to vote and comment.
Use tags connected to the audience you want to hear from.
Optionally tag a small number of relevant experts or colleagues to kick-start engagement.

required_generation_elements: Answer options that are mutually exclusive
Context for why the question matters
hard_constraints: Joke answers that make results unusable for insight (unless the poll is explicitly playful)
More than one question embedded in the caption
Options that overlap or confuse respondents
